(Currently amended) 1. A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests include unique identifiers for the creditors; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations, and are customized based on the unique identifiers; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations.

(Currently amended) 6. A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim, and a unique identifier for each creditor; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations, and are customized based on the unique identifiers; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.
